Variants.Content: The city of Vance is located in the stone land west of Dorne, and its old English name is Vais. It lies close to the steep terrain of the Red Mountains and is interconnected by roads between Starfall, Prince's Pass, and the interior of Dorne. The size of towns and the way of life here are limited by the mountains: slopes suitable for grazing, valleys that can store water, and passable passes are more valuable than large tracts of fertile farmland. The Stoney Dornish people do not need to chase oases like the nomads in the sand, nor do they rely on the sea like the residents of the Salt Coast; their tenacity comes from stones, goats, springs and the memory of every mountain road.

When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
